# Rule 0 — Staff discretion and common sense
The rules are not a complete list of every possible situation. Staff may intervene in cases that damage the server, harm the community, or abuse loopholes in the written rules.
Use common sense. If something is clearly disruptive, malicious, or against the spirit of roleplay, it may be punished even if it is not specifically named in the rules.
Staff decisions should be made to protect the health of the round, the server, and the community.
